description: Regression: piling in three units back-to-back in the 11e global Pile In step (12.02). A confirmed PileInDialog frees itself on a 0.1s timer, but the phase has already re-emitted the step data and re-enabled the unit rows — so picking the next unit straight away lands inside that window. The outgoing dialog's tree_exiting used to run _disable_pile_in_mode() over the top of the dialog that had just been armed: add_child renamed the new dialog (@AcceptDialog@NNNN, so /root/PileInDialog no longer resolved), pile_in_active went false, 'Auto Pile In' reported 'no legal move', and Confirm submitted an EMPTY pile-in that spent the unit's one move without moving a model — the reported 'it skipped the third one … the unit is not piled in'. Setup: three P1 units (Custodian Guard + two Witchseekers) each parked 0.6" from an Ork unit (engaged, not yet in base contact), everything else pushed to the board edges. Player path: click each unit's step row, Auto Pile In, Confirm — with NO pause between one unit's Confirm and the next unit's row click. All three must keep the stable /root/PileInDialog node, keep pile_in_active true, produce a real auto move, and actually advance up the board.
